youtube.title: Holidays Too Loud? Christmas Morning Prayer | Isaiah 9:6 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Christmas is three days out. Hear who it's about.

"For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace." Isaiah 9:6 (KJV)

Before the gifts and the noise, remember the child who came for you.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.
